title: The Dark Knight — A hero the city needs

hook.context: Joker qurbonlariga yaqinlashib, bu savolni masxara bilan beradi. Grammatik jihatdan to'liq gap emas (to'liqi: Why are you so serious?), lekin og'zaki nutqda bunday qisqa savollar juda ko'p uchraydi.

reading: Gotham City is full of crime. Batman fights criminals at night, and the new district attorney, Harvey Dent, fights them in court. For the first time, the city has hope.
Then a strange criminal appears: the Joker. He doesn't want money or power. He wants to prove that anyone can become evil if life pushes them hard enough.
The Joker creates chaos everywhere. He kills important people and forces Batman to make impossible choices.

In one terrible night, Batman can save only one person: Harvey or Rachel, the woman both men love. He chooses Rachel, but the Joker has given him the wrong address. Batman saves Harvey, and Rachel dies.

Harvey survives, but half of his face is badly burned. Full of anger, he becomes Two-Face and decides people's lives by tossing a coin. He thinks, "If Batman had arrived earlier, Rachel wouldn't have died."
At the end Batman takes the blame for Harvey's crimes. If the people had learned the truth about Harvey, they would have lost all hope.
Batman becomes the enemy of the city, but he protects its belief in a good hero. Sometimes, the film says, the truth is not enough.

grammar.title: Third Conditional: if I had known..., I would have...
explain: **Third conditional** — o'tmishda **sodir bo'lmagan** voqea va uning xayoliy natijasi: **If** + Past Perfect (had + V3), **would have** + V3.
**If** Batman **had arrived** earlier, Rachel **wouldn't have died**. (Haqiqatda: u kech keldi, Rachel vafot etdi.)
Ko'pincha afsus yoki tanqid uchun ishlatiladi: If I **had studied**, I **would have passed**. Og'zaki: I'**d have** passed.
Ehtiyot bo'ling: **'d** ikki xil: if qismida 'd = **had** (If I'd known), natija qismida 'd = **would** (I'd have helped).

exercises.q: If Batman had arrived earlier, Rachel ___ died.
If I ___ the truth, I would have told you.
If the people had learned the truth, they ___ all hope.
We would have caught the train if we ___ earlier.
exercises.why: if qismi gap oxirida ham Past Perfect.

exercises.q: If you'd asked me, I'd ___ helped you.
exercises.why: I'd have helped = I would have helped.

exercises.q: She ___ the exam if she had studied harder.
If it hadn't rained, we ___ to the beach.
If I'd known you were ill, I ___ you.
exercises.why: If I'd known (had) → would have + V3.
